confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bucharest prices, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is least certain and reflects a July central-Bucharest stay with taxes included. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value came from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA page and was not independently opened, so verify it against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Romanian and Central/Eastern European capital price levels (for example Sofia, Budapest and Belgrade), positioned below Western European capitals. Accommodation reflects central Bucharest in July, not an off-season rate.
